name: Grosse Pointe
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Grosse Pointe for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, all at Ford House in Grosse Pointe Shores, from photos with Santa and a Nutcracker tea to brunch with Santa and the Home for the Holidays lighted walk. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Grosse Pointe

  • 4 Christmas events for Grosse Pointe families, including Home for the Holidays at Ford House moved from the Detroit page
  • Meet Santa: photos and brunch with Santa at Ford House, with Santa at the lighted walk on December 26 and 27
  • Lights: the Home for the Holidays lighted holiday walk at Ford House

Planning a bigger day out? Grosse Pointe families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers the Detroit Symphony, Winter Wonders at Hudson's Detroit and Holiday Nights in Greenfield Village.
